styles.name: Olive green bib apron with pocket — OH ties and towel loop
styles.desc: Bib apron · Patch pocket · OH black non tangle tape ties · Towel loop in OH black non tangle tape, left side as worn
styles.lectra: AP3005 — butchers width plus pocket: variant 3005 large with standard pocket (cut pocket 9" x 11") · marker OH3005003
fabrics: Olive green 200 gsm 65% recycled polyester / 35% organic cotton X133ECO-AM298 (Tiajo) — rating 1.00 m from All Costings, the works order leaves it blank
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S OLIVE 05742 — cost per metre
Oliver Harvey British button woven label, set 4 cm down from the right side seam as worn.
Red OH tax tab set to the top left side of the pocket as worn.

Oliver Harvey wash instructions set under the OH woven label in the right side seam as worn: 65% recycled polyester / 35% organic cotton · 60° wash · tumble dry low · 2 dot iron · P dry clean · do not bleach.
OH black non tangle tape, cut 100 cm.
OH black non tangle tape, cut 39 cm from the roll.
mfg: Make neck strap. Fold in half and enclose raw edges. Edge stitch long edge to close seam.
Set bib facing and insert neck strap. Edge of neck strap to finish in line with side of bib (no step).
Edge stitched side of neck strap to be set to outside edge of bib and ensure good side of strap to topside.
Top of bib 6 mm topstitched.
Bib facing: fold in 10 mm to neaten lower edge. Edge stitch lower edge of facing, which forms 5.5 cm topstitching to front.

Armhole double turned and topstitching to finish 6 mm from edge. Insert towel loop: cut at 39 cm, fold in half and set 17 cm from cut edge of left side seam as worn. Stitch down towel loop to follow armhole stitching.
Hem double turned and topstitching to finish 12 mm from edge.
Sides double turned and topstitching to finish 12 mm from edge. Insert waist ties to finish level with top of side seam. Insert labels.
Set pocket hem: 1 cm double turned.
Set pocket centrally to front, 33 cm up from finished hem and centrally within width. Edge stitch in position. Insert red OH tax tab. Triangle stitch top of pocket mouth to secure.
Fold waist tie back on itself to fall away from garment and edge stitch down to width of strap to secure.
Double turn ends of waist tie to neaten.
fin: Pressed, trimmed and folded sides in and bib up for display.

12 x nickel plated ring press studs — mark the extra studs from the marker. Concealed female studs set to left front as worn, set before make-up. After make-up set male studs: align fronts and mark for male studs.
Set to left side seam as worn, 10 cm up from cut hem, to finish 8 cm from finished hem.
Set centrally to back panel, 4 cm down from finished neck seam. Edgestitch in position in same colour as garment.
Set to centre back neck into neck seam, on top of care label.
Tibard pre-printed care label / size: 65% polyester 35% cotton · 60° wash · tumble dry · do not bleach · 2 dot iron · P dry clean. Set underneath the Tibard centre fold label at centre back neck.
mfg: Cutting: set the female studs (x 12, the extra set marked from the marker) pre-make-up — concealed, left front as worn. No pen pocket.
Make collar and edgestitch.
Set Tibard label to back of jacket.
Join up on 5 thread. Neaten front facing edge. Join back panels, join shoulders, set collar, set sleeves, join underarm / side seam. Insert labels. Neaten body hem.
Set front facing. Stitch at width 13 cm from hem up and run up to neck, 6 mm topstitch back neck and then back down front. Ensure fronts lie flat.
Set body hem. Turn up 1.7 cm. Topstitch 1.5 cm.
Set long sleeve hem: double turn (1 cm + 1.6 cm) and topstitch 1.5 cm.
